text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour AML training (certification required)
- Customer-facing staff: Additional 1-hour practical scenarios
- Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist certifications  
**Training Topics:**
- Money laundering methods and trends
- AML/CFT regulatory framework
- Red flags and suspicious indicators
- Company procedures and systems
- Tipping off and confidentiality
- SAR filing process
- Sanctions screening
- Customer scenarios and case studies  
**Non-Compliance:** Failure to complete training = disciplinary action

raw_entities.name: Training and Awareness Policy
raw_entities.description: A mandatory training and awareness policy requiring all staff to complete annual AML training with certification, supplemented by role-specific training for customer-facing and compliance personnel. The policy establishes training content requirements covering money laundering methods, regulatory frameworks, red flags, and SAR filing procedures, with disciplinary consequences for non-compliance.
context: Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist certifications
Failure to complete training = disciplinary action

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual AML Training for All Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members are required to complete a 1-hour AML training course annually with certification as a mandatory requirement.

raw_entities.name: Additional Practical Scenario Training for Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Customer-facing staff must complete an additional 1-hour practical scenarios training course beyond the mandatory annual AML training.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Updates and Specialist Certifications for Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Compliance staff must receive quarterly training updates and obtain specialist certifications as part of their ongoing professional development obligations.
context: Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist certifications

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Money Laundering Methods and Trends
raw_entities.description: Training must cover current money laundering methods and emerging trends to ensure staff awareness of evolving financial crime techniques.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on AML/CFT Regulatory Framework
raw_entities.description: Training must include comprehensive coverage of the AML/CFT regulatory framework applicable to the organization.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Red Flags and Suspicious Indicators
raw_entities.description: Training must educate staff on identifying red flags and suspicious indicators that may indicate money laundering or terrorist financing activity.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Company Procedures and Systems
raw_entities.description: Training must cover the organization's internal AML procedures and systems to ensure staff understand how to apply policies in practice.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Tipping Off and Confidentiality
raw_entities.description: Training must address tipping off prohibitions and confidentiality obligations to ensure staff understand legal restrictions on disclosing SAR filings and investigations.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on SAR Filing Process
raw_entities.description: Training must include instruction on the Suspicious Activity Report filing process, including when and how to file SARs with the relevant authority.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Training must cover sanctions screening procedures and obligations to ensure staff can identify and handle sanctioned individuals and entities.

raw_entities.name: Training Content on Customer Scenarios and Case Studies
raw_entities.description: Training must include practical customer scenarios and case studies to provide real-world context for identifying and responding to AML risks.

raw_entities.name: Disciplinary Action for Training Non-Compliance
raw_entities.description: Failure to complete mandatory training results in disciplinary action against the staff member.
context: Failure to complete training = disciplinary action

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: The risk of the organization being used to facilitate the conversion of illegally obtained funds into apparently legitimate assets, addressed through staff training on money laundering methods, trends, and detection indicators.

raw_entities.name: Terrorist Financing
raw_entities.description: The risk of the organization facilitating the transfer of funds to support terrorist activities, addressed through the AML/CFT regulatory framework training and sanctions screening procedures.

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members are required to complete 1-hour annual AML training with certification and must comply with training requirements or face disciplinary action.
context: Failure to complete training = disciplinary action

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Customer-facing staff have enhanced training obligations, including the mandatory annual AML training plus an additional 1-hour practical scenarios training to prepare them for real-world customer interactions involving AML risks.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Compliance staff have the most intensive training obligations, including quarterly updates and specialist certifications to maintain expertise in AML/CFT regulatory requirements and procedures.
context: Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist certifications

raw_entities.name: Staff Training Program
raw_entities.description: A mandatory annual training program for all staff covering AML/CFT topics, with role-specific enhancements for customer-facing and compliance personnel, designed to ensure staff awareness and competence in identifying and responding to money laundering and terrorist financing risks.
context: Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist certifications

raw_entities.name: Training Certification Requirement
raw_entities.description: Certification is required upon completion of mandatory AML training to provide evidence of staff compliance and competence.
